name: AW Championship
epitaph: Anarchy Wrestling’s top singles belt, awarded vacant to The Nameless on 21 December 2005 and carried in turn by Rated R, Gerard Angelo and Tommy Purr before Halloween Jack took it from Tommy in a four-way ladder match at Wars of the World on 30 September 2006. Tommy won it back at Dead By Dawn under a guest referee, and Battle of the Warriors 2007 bills Rated R as champion; the champions page, captured in April 2007, ends with Tommy’s second reign.

name: AW Xtreme Championship
epitaph: A belt for the company’s high-flyers and brawlers alike, awarded vacant to Hoshi Yakamoto on 21 December 2005 and passed through a battle royal, a table-filled rumble, an open challenge and a hardcore main event. Hoshi holds it three times by its own champions page, which dates Frank Merritt’s first reign to 7 October 2006 though the 23 September Insurgence shows him winning it a week earlier.

name: AW Superior Championship
epitaph: Created at the first Battle of the Warriors, on 18 January 2006, in a five-man battle royal won by Max Cameron. Max walked out with the belt on 12 February when he was let go, Bombshell won it vacant that night, Diego Alvarez and The Moose followed, and the title was dissolved on 1 July 2006 when The Moose won the CWA Alpha title.

events.note: Its champions page says the title was dissolved when The Moose won the Alpha title on 1 July 2006.

name: AW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Anarchy Wrestling’s tag belts, won by Aftermath and Cameron Jacques in a seven-team challenge on 5 February 2006 and vacated a week later when Max Cameron left with his stable’s belts. Air Canada, De’Anton Maybon and Parker Davis, S.E.X., Delirium and the New Age Dogg Pound followed, and Vigilante and The Moose took them in a four-corners match at Wars of the World on 30 September 2006.

name: AW Anarchy Monarchy title
epitaph: A crown created at Battle of the Warriors 2006, in a four-way won by Myst, with Scavenger announcing that once a month someone would challenge the king or queen of AW. Its champions page lists a Monarch for each month through November 2006 and notes no pay-per-view in March, ten holders in all.

name: CWA Alpha Championship
epitaph: The CWA’s own title inside Anarchy Wrestling’s 2006 run, decided by a tournament whose final The Nameless won over Trinity Holmes on 28 May 2006. The Moose won it on 1 July, defended it in a steel cell at Wars of the World and lost it to Rated R in the octagon at Dead By Dawn.
